question: Does any pair of pendant-arm multisets on two hubs, with total pendant weight strictly above 24, violate B log-concavity, C ~_p B, or xC ~_p B, where B is the adjacent-hub (t=0) polynomial and C is the contracted-hub (merged spider) polynomial? C log-concavity is checked only as a harness self-check (it is a theorem: Li-Li-Yang-Zhang, arXiv:2501.04245, all spiders are strongly log-concave).
scan_two_branch_lc_coverage_note: scan_two_branch_lc.py exhaustively enumerates C2 trees by total vertex order n (default max_n=24), which bounds pendant weight plus hubs plus connector vertices together and uses a fixed (small) connector length implied by that order; it therefore does not reach pendant weight above 24 combined with an unbounded connector, and does not cover the search space explored here. Not rerun.
